subject: Junior Civil Draftsperson application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello LC Water team,

I'm applying for the Junior Civil Draftsperson role in Geelong that I saw on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, reviewing drawings and checking work against them. I'm based in Melton VIC with a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa.

Your advert says the role shows how drawings turn into real construction, and that is what I want from my first drafting job: site layouts, slabs, foundations and access roads updated from engineer mark-ups. My CAD work so far is from study rather than commercial drafting, and I haven't worked on water or wastewater projects yet, so I would start at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
